name: W Osaka
positioning: A Tadao Ando-supervised black monolith on Midosuji Boulevard that hides a colorful, neon-lit interior, steps from Dotonbori's nightlife
best_for: Travelers who want to be steps from Dotonbori's nightlife
Design lovers drawn to a minimalist exterior with a playful, colorful interior

facts.text: The hotel is on Midosuji Boulevard.
Dotonbori's nightlife is just steps away.
Guest rooms are decorated with neon lights.
Suite bathrooms include rain showers and deep soaking bathtubs.
AWAY Spa has a relaxation zone, sauna, steam room and beauty bar.
The FIT gym has Technogym equipment and a yoga room.
The Living Room bar combines a cocktail bar, dining area and DJ booth.
Teppanyaki MYDO serves Japanese and teppan cuisine in a space designed by an Osaka-born artist.
A Whatever/Whenever button in every room gives access to 24/7 service.

highlights.text: The hotel's black monolith facade, supervised by architect Tadao Ando, has a minimalist exterior that conceals a colorful interior.
The WET indoor pool is neon-lit, next to the open-air WET Deck terrace.
The hotel has a glittering, color-changing entrance tunnel.
The Penthouse suite on the top floor has a living and social room with a DJ booth.
The spa has a couple's treatment room with a private bathtub.

considerations.text: Pool access is limited to staying guests aged 16 or above.
The WET Bar is open seasonally.
WhataHotel notes the contemporary lifestyle style may not suit traditional preferences.
